provenance.nativeVariant: Hand-authored, verified field-by-field against openGym-longevity commit 375959ffb8f212874c632e23b89e14699f6cf3f2, frontend/src/sheets.jsx doFinishWorkout() (lines 917-951) and SessionRating() (lines 858-871). openGym has no exported pure function producing this shape (it is assembled inline inside a store-mutating UI event handler), so unlike the CSV-import variant below this portion cannot be machine-captured without adding a new export to the source app, which this phase deliberately avoids (see contracts/WORKOUT_LEDGER_SOURCE_CONTRACT_V1.md and the 'no source app redesign' constraint). Every field name, type, and construction rule here is cross-checked against that source read, not invented.
